pages.title: Rainforest Ridge Lodge & Venue, The Crags, Plettenberg Bay
pages.description: The ideal blend of raw nature and comfortable luxury. Stylish guest lodge with panoramic untouched views over mountains, forest & ocean. Set on an 11ha private nature reserve with a rainforest gorge and access to the Salt River and Tsitsikamma national park.

Welcome to Rainforest Ridge!
From the moment you come through the gate you ll be surrounded by beauty and creativity as far as the eye can see. The vista s from the mountain escarpment right through the gorges to the Indian Ocean are truly unforgettable. Your private Eden awaits...
We also offer the most divine weddings and events
The ridge venue overlooking the gorge is a truly perfect setting for creating special moments/memories. Guests of the lodge are welcome to make use of all the facilities across the property!
The Lodge is set on a cliff overlooking 2 gorges, Mt Formosa and endless untouched wilderness
Hidden below in the gorge is the banana palm rainforest and over 5km of private trails to explore!!
The venue at night is so cosy
It really feels like an alien spaceship touched down. The perfect spot to spend a sunset through till late!
The Ridge Braai with actual 360* views
For the ultimate sundowner braai with that wild feeling, our ridge braai is the spot. As a guest your welcome to use it free of charge from dawn till 10pm.
How about a swim in the olympic size dam?
So much more fun than an infinity pool! The 1 million litre dam is situated just behind the lodge and is perfect for a dip at any time and its the ultimate star-gazing spot late at night.
5* Fresh Cotton Bedding
All our beds are XL and super comfortable
Wanna explore hidden mountain springs?
As a guest our guides can give you free advice on amazing adventures off the beaten track between the Mountains and Ocean
Mt Formosa at 1675m is often snow-capped in Winter!
From the bedrooms in the lodge and cottage there is a beautiful view of the stunning Mt Formosa to be enjoyed. The sunrises right behind it in Winter its breathtaking!
Take in the first rays of sun from your private deck overlooking the gorge, mountains and ocean beyond!
Watching the sun come up from the deck as you slowly awaken in full tranquility is a special feeling that will stay with you for long to come!
Lekker Kuier?
With comfortable accommodation for up to 12 people, proper sound equipment and lekker vibes we truly can help you pull off that special 10pp-50pp event in style
Who would you like to enjoy breakfast with overlooking this?
We deliver 5* Eggs Benedict and the like from our local award-winning restaurant Peppermill. Just let us know what time suits you and our friendly staff will deliver your breakfast to wherever you feel like on the property!
Our Private Sub-Tropical Rainforest!
Below the ridge in the gorge you will find our sub-tropical rainforest which is dominated by ferns and thick stands of wild giant strelitzias (wild banana palms)
African Crags is under new ownership and is being revamped & reopened as Rainforest Ridge Lodge & Venue
We are proud to announce that under new ownership we have spent the lockdown period building, renovating, landscaping and designing the ultimate lockdown decompression retreat that we are now ready to welcome you too!
Milly the Rainforest Guide!
Milly the dog is a beautiful Malamute girl who works as our private guide of the rainforest and river. Free of charge she would love to look after you and show you the way to the river safely!
She knows our private nature reserve better than anyone and loves nothing more than to show guests her favorite spots. If she does a good job you can tip her with a raw bone!
Once the sun rises above Mt Formosa you will warm up fast in the early morning sun on your deck
Spending time on the deck overlooking such raw nature but with all the creature comforts and luxurious touches at the lodge is definitely a vibe!
Welcome to Rainforest Ridge
The Ridge is a long peninsula of land that sticks out with gorgeous gorges of around 200m depth on 3 sides!. We have the only safe entrance to a stretch of Tsitsikamma river and rainforest only accesible via our 11ha private nature reserve!
Your Braai at sunset with friends awaits!
Guests can make use of all facilities on the property free of charge!
If its not booked out for an event guests can make use of our XXL safari style braai on the ridge! Its 150m away from the lodge overlooking the Salt River gorge. The ultimate spot for sundowners with your family/friends truly.
Peaceful Mornings
Enjoy the bird sound while the ocean rumbles in the distance. Gaze out as far as they eye can see at nothing but Proteas, Fynbos and Rainforest.
Our head of security Ruby the Saintolian
The ridge and The Crags is one of the safest areas in South Africa. Especially with Ruby doing her night patrols which she is trained for. Shhhhh dont tell anyone she is extremely sweet and cuddly!
There is a few family s of Knysna Loeries living in our gorge!
For bird watching your at the right place! dedicated twitchers/photographers will be kept busy here for days trying to capture the perfect image or chasing distant bird sounds echoing off the gorge!
How about a lazy stroll around our nature reserve picking your own wildflowers!
We have multiple rare wild fynbos plants and even South Africas national flower growing on the property, the king protea!
Spot the snow on the top face of Mt Formosa
When the big winter storms roll in from the Southern Ocean we see snowfall along the whole range. Mt Formosa at 1675m is snowcapped for days sometimes!
Swimming in your private rock pool!
A 15 minute hike down to the bottom of our gorge brings you to the Salt River were you can swim amongst the fairys!
Sunrise gazing from your deck or kingsize bed?
The sunrises here over the untouched gorge are truly breathtaking!
Wine Tasting at the neighbors!
Around The Crags there is 5-6 boutique vineyards including our neighbor the famous Bramon wine estate!
Dont want to drink and drive? No worries one of our staff can be your designated driver!

Boho Private Lodge
Bohemian styled private lodge that is the perfect blend of comfort and artistic style surrounded by the most gorgeous of nature with panoramic views!
The Lodge sleeps up to 10 people across 4 bedrooms. It is also perfectly cosy for a couple or a smaller group and is fully private. The space is split into 2 seperate wings that both open up onto the living area and kitchen/dining room. Outside there is a large deck perched over the gorge with the most breathtaking of views.
There is also a private undercover stoep area to enjoy with a pizza oven and gas braai equipped.

Canyon Cabins
Perched at the end of the ridge overlooking the gorge and Ocean the view from the cabins is truly majestic. Privacy, Comfort and Serenity are guaranteed
Both Cabins have a King bed and a single so can accomodate up to 3 people. They each have their own private stylish bathrooms (with views) and a private deck. They are connected up to the venue by wood boardwalks where you have access to the venue kitchen and all the venue facilities. The whole venue is basically your oversized living room and you are welcome to make use of the facilities like the DJ system and pool table,
Comfortable bohemian luxury and untouched wild nature is the recipe. The sunrise over the gorge from this cabin is beyond mesmerizing and feels ethereal!
